title: Boundary-First RoboCup Collaboration Program

audience.name: RoboCup researchers, teams, and technical committees

hero.headline: Translate tactical understanding into something machines and researchers can test.
hero.support: Boundary First Labs proposes a bounded research program that formalizes selected concepts from human soccer into explicit representations for autonomous multi-agent soccer.

bridge.source: Boundary-First Soccer provides a human-readable vocabulary for boundary, invariant, closure, defect, promotion, responsibility, and repair.
bridge.target: RoboCup environments provide reproducible multi-agent states, policies, logs, replays, and increasingly embodied systems.
bridge.firstQuestion: Can a narrow tactical ontology be operationalized reliably and add explanatory or engineering value beyond ordinary state and event descriptions?

sequence: decide whether a co-design study is warranted
pilot.initialAsk: Review a five-sequence concept package and tell us where the representation fails.

claimBoundary: Independent Boundary First Labs proposal. No RoboCup affiliation, endorsement, partnership, paper acceptance, league membership, or performance improvement is claimed.
